COLUMBIA, Md., January 05, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--COPT Defense Properties (NYSE: CDP) ("COPT Defense" or the "Company") announced that its Board of Trustees elected Robert L. Denton, Sr. to serve as Chairman of the Board, effective January 1, 2024.
